title: Matrix 4 Ressurections coffee shop fight. Trinity Bugs switch scene. What happened here?

commenti.body:
Trinity was plugged into the Matrix through her pod. They needed to move her body in the real world before she was going to be able to get to an exit in the virtual world. They had a machine friend who could act as a mobile hotspot into the virtual world. So, they needed to move Trinity from the connection in her pod to the connection on their mobile hotspot without properly exiting her. 

The solution, as I remember it, was to plug Bugs into the mobile hotspot, then plug Trinity into Bugs, then disconnect Trinity from her pod. Trinity could stay connected to the Matrix through Bugs, with Bugs basically acting as a VPN or proxy for Trinity for a moment. Then they connected Trinity directly to their hotspot and disconnected her from Bugs.
